candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with assignment to admin so setOwner changes admin instead of owner.
Remove the assignment to owner so calling setOwner no longer updates owner.
Assign owner to tx.origin instead of provided _owner, so owner becomes transaction origin after setOwner.
Change onlyAdmin require to check msg.sender == owner so only the current owner can call setOwner, altering who can change owner and thus the resulting owner after setOwner.
Change the function to return false after setting owner instead of true.

Alter the onlyAdmin modifier to allow anyone (no revert) so setOwner can be called by non-admins and still return its result; keeps behavior of setOwner's return value but changes caller permission which can affect observable outcome when caller differs.
Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can change owner (was restricted to admin).

Changed the require check in onlyAdmin to compare against owner instead of admin, making owner able to call admin-only functions (thus allowing setOwner caller when onlyAdmin is enforced to be owner rather than admin).
